meta.notes: Seed history assembled from public release tables (TradingEconomics, Investing.com economic calendar, NBS/PBOC releases, x-rates.com). A few series carry known data-quality flags — see per-series 'flag' field. Auto-refreshed on schedule via GitHub Actions using akshare.

gdp_growth.label: Real GDP Growth
gdp_growth.flag: 2025-Q1 and 2025-Q2 not found in sourced snippets — gap.
gdp_growth.desc: The year-over-year change in the total value of goods and services China produces — the broadest measure of economic growth.

industrial_production.label: Industrial Production
industrial_production.flag: China does not publish a standalone January reading (combined with Feb around Lunar New Year).
industrial_production.desc: The year-over-year change in output from China's factories, mines, and utilities.

retail_sales.label: Retail Sales
retail_sales.flag: May 2026 was the first y/y decline since Dec 2022.
retail_sales.desc: The year-over-year change in consumer spending at stores and other retail outlets.

fixed_asset_investment.label: Fixed Asset Investment (YTD)
fixed_asset_investment.flag: Now computed live from NBS cumulative investment data (this year's YTD vs last year's YTD through the same month) — resolves the Feb/Mar 2026 anomaly flagged in earlier web-sourced data. Current July 2026 reading (-9.7%) differs from an earlier press citation (-6.7%), likely a methodology difference between this series and the headline NBS figure.
fixed_asset_investment.desc: Cumulative year-to-date growth in spending on long-lived assets like factories, infrastructure, and real estate, compared to the same period last year.

official_manufacturing_pmi.label: Official Manufacturing PMI
official_manufacturing_pmi.desc: A survey-based gauge of factory activity; readings above 50 signal expansion, below 50 signal contraction.

caixin_manufacturing_pmi.label: Caixin Manufacturing PMI
caixin_manufacturing_pmi.flag: Only 4 months found in free sources. Since mid-2025 sometimes co-branded 'RatingDog Manufacturing PMI' — same underlying series.
caixin_manufacturing_pmi.desc: A private-sector survey of factory activity skewed toward smaller, export-oriented firms; above 50 signals expansion.

official_non_manufacturing_pmi.label: Official Non-Manufacturing PMI
official_non_manufacturing_pmi.desc: A survey-based gauge of activity in services and construction; above 50 signals expansion.

cpi.label: CPI Inflation
cpi.desc: The year-over-year change in prices paid by consumers for a basket of goods and services.

ppi.label: PPI Inflation
ppi.flag: Swing from -1.9% (Dec '25) to +4.1% (Jun '26) is a genuine, sharply reported reflation story, not a data artifact.
ppi.desc: The year-over-year change in prices producers receive for their output, an early signal of inflation or deflation pressure working through the economy.

lpr_1y.label: 1-Year Loan Prime Rate
lpr_1y.flag: Held unchanged since May 2025 — 14 consecutive monthly fixings on hold through Jul 2026 per Aug 2026 sourcing.
lpr_1y.desc: The benchmark rate banks use to price most new loans; sets the general cost of short-term borrowing.

lpr_5y.label: 5-Year Loan Prime Rate
lpr_5y.desc: The benchmark rate banks use to price longer-term loans, most notably mortgages.

rrr.label: Reserve Requirement Ratio (Large Banks)
rrr.desc: The share of deposits large banks must hold in reserve rather than lend out; lowering it frees up money for banks to lend.
rrr.flag: Tracks 大型银行 (large banks) specifically, verified against PBOC's own live current-value page and CEIC (both 7.5% as of Aug 2026) — a different, ~1.5pp-lower category than what the underlying akshare function's own column actually reports ("large financial institutions"). History before ~2015 is reconstructed by offset from that series and not independently verified; the current value and recent cuts (2022+) are confirmed against press-reported figures.

m2_growth.label: M2 Money Supply Growth
m2_growth.desc: The year-over-year growth of the broad money supply — cash, deposits, and near-money — a gauge of overall credit conditions.

tsf_flow.label: Total Social Financing (flow)
tsf_flow.flag: Monthly flow, not the TSF stock y/y growth rate — that series wasn't cleanly sourced. Large month-to-month swings are normal (quarter-end/tax-season patterns).
tsf_flow.desc: The total new financing — bank loans, bonds, and other credit — flowing into China's economy in a given month.

m1_growth.label: M1 Money Supply Growth
m1_growth.desc: The year-over-year growth of cash and readily-spendable deposits, a gauge of short-term liquidity and near-term business activity.

m1_m2_gap.label: M1-M2 Gap
m1_m2_gap.desc: The gap between M1 and M2 growth; a widening negative gap suggests money is sitting idle in savings rather than being spent or invested.

exports_yoy.label: Exports (USD)
exports_yoy.flag: 20-30%+ y/y prints in 2026 look high — plausibly a low base plus tariff front-loading, but not cross-checked against GACC primary data.
exports_yoy.desc: The year-over-year change in the US-dollar value of goods China sells abroad.

imports_yoy.label: Imports (USD)
imports_yoy.desc: The year-over-year change in the US-dollar value of goods China buys from abroad.

trade_balance.label: Trade Balance
trade_balance.desc: The difference between exports and imports in US dollars; positive means China sold more than it bought.

usdcny.label: USD/CNY
usdcny.flag: Sourced from x-rates.com aggregated market averages, not PBOC's official daily fixing — directionally reliable, not pip-precise.
usdcny.desc: How many yuan it takes to buy one US dollar; a rising number means the yuan is weakening.

fx_reserves.label: FX Reserves
fx_reserves.desc: The stockpile of foreign currency, mostly US dollars, held by China's central bank.

property_investment.label: Real Estate Investment (YTD)
property_investment.flag: 2025 monthly series has gaps (Mar 2025 not found).
property_investment.desc: Cumulative year-to-date growth in spending on real estate development, a bellwether for the property sector's health.

new_home_prices.label: New Home Prices, 70-City
new_home_prices.flag: Requested as m/m but only a y/y series was reliably sourced — axis is y/y, not month-over-month.
new_home_prices.desc: The year-over-year change in new-home prices across major Chinese cities.

urban_unemployment.label: Surveyed Urban Unemployment
urban_unemployment.desc: The share of China's urban labor force that is surveyed as unemployed and actively seeking work.

youth_unemployment.label: Youth Unemployment (16-24)
youth_unemployment.flag: All points use the post-Dec-2023 methodology (excludes enrolled students). Jul 2026 jump to 17.9% reflects seasonal new-graduate entry.
youth_unemployment.desc: The unemployment rate among 16–24 year-olds, excluding enrolled students.
